policy: No adoption without acceptable license/provenance, demonstrated 4.7.1 compatibility, isolated A/B proof, Web/GL Compatibility impact measurement, and measured superiority over any working project-specific system.

candidates.name: Beehave
candidates.compatibility_evidence: Store changelog states v2.9.3 is compatible with latest Godot 4.7.
candidates.maintenance_evidence: Recent 2026-08-18 release; store description states automated test coverage and built-in performance monitors.
candidates.reason: Promising maintained AI tooling, but no isolated Grand Bruxelles Web/GL performance/export A/B exists and current NPC runtime ownership must not be displaced without measured superiority.

candidates.name: Dialogue Manager
candidates.compatibility_evidence: Store minimum is Godot 4.6; explicit 4.7.1 qualification was not found in this audit.
candidates.maintenance_evidence: Updated 2026-09-06 with active-maintainer community evidence on the official store.
candidates.reason: Do not integrate until 4.7.1 and Web/GL compatibility are demonstrated in isolation; dialogue is not the current visible CIV-1 blocker.

candidates.name: Universal Animation Library
candidates.compatibility_evidence: Official store describes a universal humanoid rig and Godot-ready retargeting, but does not establish exact Godot 4.7.1 qualification.
candidates.maintenance_evidence: Official-store release updated 2026-06-10; 10 reviews are present.
candidates.reason: Potentially useful for idle/walk/run coverage, but the store marks it unstable and a 2026 review reports UpperChest deformation on other characters. Require CIV-1 skeleton/BoneMap retarget A/B, foot-slide/grounding measurements, source hash intake, and player-view proof before adoption.

candidates.name: Character State Machine
candidates.compatibility_evidence: Official store declares minimum Godot 4.6 and maximum Godot 4.7.
candidates.maintenance_evidence: Recent 2026 release but no reviews; publisher marks version unstable.
candidates.reason: Version range is promising but 4.7.1 patch-level and Web/GL behavior are not proven; no reason to replace project-specific state handling without measured superiority.

next_executable_action: When CIV-1 source is legally acquired, test Universal Animation Library only in an isolated branch: record exact package/source hashes, inspect Skeleton3D/BoneMap mapping, measure root displacement versus character velocity for idle/walk/run, verify foot contact/grounding at 2-8 m, measure Web/GL frame cost, and capture a real 1280x720 player-view artifact. Do not merge on store metadata alone.
